title: BSWAP flips the byte order but does not flip the bits within the byte
applies: 64-bit mode for x86-64; Intel SDM Volume 1 and Volume 2
detail: Memory dumps shown as little-endian bytes and register hexadecimal printouts are often in reverse order, so the comparison object should be clarified first.
boundary: The bit reverse order of a single byte is another operation. For example, the eight-bit reverse order of 0x01 is 0x80.
relevance: Determine whether the transformation in the buffer changes the byte order or the bit order of each byte.
